```sql
SELECT page, CASE WHEN YEAR(event_time) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(event_time) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END event_cohort, COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/checkout' THEN 1 END) checkout_count FROM web_events WHERE event_time < '2024-03-01' OR session_id IN (8, 10, 13, 15) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING checkout_count >= 5 ORDER BY page, event_cohort
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") < "2024-03-01") | F.col("session_id").isin([8, 10, 13, 15]))
    .groupBy(
        "page",
        F.when(F.year("event_time") < 2024, "before_2024").when(F.year("event_time") == 2024, "2024").otherwise("after_2024").alias("event_cohort"),
    )
    .agg(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/checkout", 1)).alias("checkout_count"))
    .filter(F.col("checkout_count") >= 5)
    .orderBy("page", "event_cohort")
)
```

```sql
WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.shipping_fee,
        d.status,
        d.order_date
    FROM order_items e
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON e.order_id = d.id
),
enriched_order_items AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_id_min_quantity,
        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_sum_shipping_fee,
        SUM(quantity) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_quantity,
        ROUND(quantity / SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id), 4) AS quantity_share
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipping_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched_order_items_2 AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.brand,
        p.price,
        p.launch_date
    FROM enriched_order_items a
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON a.product_id = p.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(price) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_avg_price,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS price_quartiles,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand)) AS brand_list,
    ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price,
    ROUND(SUM(quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS quantity_per_completed
FROM enriched_order_items_2
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY quantity_per_completed DESC NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.shipping_fee"), F.col("d.status"), F.col("d.order_date"))
)

enriched_order_items = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("quantity").over(w).alias("product_id_min_quantity"),
        F.sum("shipping_fee").over(w2).alias("order_id_sum_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w_ordered).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity") / F.sum("quantity").over(w)), 4).alias("quantity_share"),
    )
)

enriched_order_items_2 = (
    enriched_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.brand"), F.col("p.price"), F.col("p.launch_date"))
)

result = (
    enriched_order_items_2
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("price"))).alias("completed_avg_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("price", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("price_quartiles"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand")).alias("brand_list"),
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price"), 2).alias("avg_unit_price"),
        F.round(F.sum("quantity") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("quantity_per_completed"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_per_completed").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 100 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 29 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_level,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
      AND status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(cost) AS cost_whole,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_clean_2
    FROM base
    WHERE shipped_date > TO_DATE('2024-03-20')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_level,
        carrier_clean,
        cost_whole,
        carrier_clean_2,
        LAST_VALUE(cost_whole) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost_whole,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY cost_whole DESC, id) AS cost_whole_bucket,
        LAG(cost_whole, 1) OVER (ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS prev_cost_whole,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_5_prior,
        AVG(cost_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_whole_avg_3_prior
    FROM valid
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        cost_level,
        carrier_clean,
        cost_whole,
        carrier_clean_2,
        last_known_cost_whole,
        cost_whole_bucket,
        prev_cost_whole,
        cost_avg_5_prior,
        cost_whole_avg_3_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY cost_whole_avg_3_prior DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_whole_avg_3_prior_rank,
        AVG(cost_whole_avg_3_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost_whole_avg_3_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior
    FROM with_windows
),
scored_shipments AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(cost_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cost_whole,
        SUM(cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior) OVER w_ordered AS running_cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS cost_share
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY carrier, status ORDER BY cost_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        o.order_date,
        o.channel
    FROM scored_shipments e
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON e.order_id = o.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    status,
    carrier_clean,
    cost_whole,
    carrier_clean_2,
    last_known_cost_whole,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(RETURNED|IN_TRANSIT)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN status RLIKE '^(DELIVERED|LOST)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS status_zone
FROM with_dims
ORDER BY order_id DESC, status_zone;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost_whole").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_whole", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_whole", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("cost_whole_avg_3_prior").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost_whole_avg_3_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("cost_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull() & (F.col("status") == "IN_TRANSIT"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("cost") >= 100, "High").when(F.col("cost") >= 29, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("cost_level"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-03-20")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ceil("cost").alias("cost_whole"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_clean_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last_known_cost_whole", F.last("cost_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
    .withColumn("cost_whole_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w2))
    .withColumn("prev_cost_whole", F.lag("cost_whole", 1).over(w3))
    .withColumn("cost_avg_5_prior", F.avg("cost").over(w4))
    .withColumn("cost_whole_avg_3_prior", F.avg("cost_whole").over(w5))
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("cost_whole_avg_3_prior_rank"),
        F.avg("cost_whole_avg_3_prior").over(w7).alias("cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

scored_shipments = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("cost_whole").over(w8).alias("running_cost_whole"),
        F.sum("cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior").over(w_ordered).alias("running_cost_whole_avg_3_prior_avg_6_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w10)), 4).alias("cost_share"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    scored_shipments
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("o.channel"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "carrier_clean",
        "cost_whole",
        "carrier_clean_2",
        "last_known_cost_whole",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(RETURNED|IN_TRANSIT)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(DELIVERED|LOST)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("status_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_id").desc(), "status_zone")
)
```

```sql
    select
```

```sql
        sum(next_cost) over (partition by carrier, status order by order_order_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_next_cost,

    from with_dims_shipments
),
daily as (

    select
        date_trunc('month', shipped_date) as activity_month,

        count(*) as row_count,
        sum(cost) filter (where status = 'LOST') as lost_total_cost

)
```

```python
w_recent = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("next_cost").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("next_cost", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("order_order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_dims = (
    df_shipments
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.amount"), F.col("o.channel"), F.col("o.order_date"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost", 1).over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_carrier", F.first("carrier", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent))
)
```

```python
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("is_new_session").desc_nulls_last())

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

filtered = (
    islands
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 17:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "k",
        "has_fault",
        F.round("status_code_high", 0).alias("status_code_high_rounded"),
    )
)

prev_events = filtered.withColumn("prev_log_ts", F.lag("log_ts").over(w))

gaps_2 = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_log_ts").isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.col("prev_log_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps_2.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

latest = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "prev_log_ts").alias("year_start"),
        "session_no",
        F.when(F.col("status_code_high_rounded") >= 73, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_code_high_rounded_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("is_new_session", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("is_new_session_quartiles"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "trace", 1)).alias("trace_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("k")).alias("k_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS balance_avg_2_prior,
        LEAD(balance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_balance,
        LAST_VALUE(balance, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_balance
    FROM accounts
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date DESC) AS row_num
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.txn_type
    FROM latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.txn_time < s.opened_date
        )
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date) AS week_start,
    txn_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(next_balance, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_balance_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(balance, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS balance_quartiles,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(account_type)) AS num_account_types,
    ROUND(SUM(last_known_balance) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS last_known_balance_per_closed
FROM kept
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date), txn_type
ORDER BY txn_type DESC;
```

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

metrics = (
    df_accounts
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("balance").over(w).alias("balance_avg_2_prior"),
        F.lead("balance", 2).over(w2).alias("next_balance"),
        F.last("balance", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_balance"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w4))
```

```python
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("running_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("running_duration_sec", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_count_90d").desc(), "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("quarter_start").orderBy(F.col("th_rows").desc())

latest = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .withColumn("prev_duration_sec", F.lag("duration_sec", 1).over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_duration_sec", F.sum("duration_sec").over(w3))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_count_90d", F.count("duration_sec").over(w5))
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.browser"), F.col("p.device"), F.col("p.country"))
)

metrics_web_events = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_browser"),
        F.lag("prev_duration_sec", 1).over(w7).alias("prev_prev_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(w8).alias("event_seq"),
```

```sql
base as (
```
```sql
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
```
```sql
    select
```

```sql
        service,
        host,
        k,
        status_code_high,
        cast(status_code as double) as status_code_str,
        coalesce(k, 'UNKNOWN') as k_filled
    from parsed
    where status_code = 374
)
select
    id,
    k,
    status_code_high,
    status_code_str,
    k_filled
from base
```

```python
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)

        "txn_time",
```

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("pos").asc_nulls_first())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("promo")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("pos").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy("promo_sum_pos")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("pos_dense_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("promo_sum_pos_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select("*", F.posexplode("items").alias("pos", "elem"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "pos",
        F.col("elem.product_id"),
        F.col("elem.qty"),
        F.col("elem.price"),
        F.col("elem.promo"),
    )
```

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("prev_txn_time", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("prev_txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("session_start_flag").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant").orderBy("session_start_flag", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy("island_id", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("account_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount_share", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant")
w12 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("session_no").desc(), "id")
w13 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("session_start_flag_bucket", "id")

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_txn_time").isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.col("prev_txn_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

deduped = (
    sessions_transactions
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

flagged = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_txn_time") - F.lag("prev_txn_time").over(w4) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    filtered
    .withColumn("session_no_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w12))
    .withColumn("session_start_flag_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w13))

        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",

        "is_flagged",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("k")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w11 = Window.partitionBy("k", "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

scored = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("status_code_sum_1h", F.sum("status_code").over(w))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_max_2h", F.max("latency_ms").over(w3))
    .withColumn("status_code_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_running))
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_sum_1h",
        "latency_ms_dense_rank",
        "latency_ms_max_2h",
        "status_code_dense_rank",
        F.date_trunc("year", "log_ts").alias("log_ts_period"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code_dense_rank") * 1.07), 2).alias("adjusted_status_code_dense_rank"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("status_code_sum_1h").over(w5).alias("status_code_sum_1h_max_30m"),
        F.avg("latency_ms").over(w6).alias("latency_ms_avg_7d"),

)

scored_app_logs = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("latency_ms").over(w8).alias("k_min_latency_ms"),
        F.max("status_code_dense_rank").over(w9).alias("service_max_status_code_dense_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_sum_1h",
        "latency_ms_dense_rank",
        "status_code_dense_rank",
        "log_ts_period",
        "adjusted_status_code_dense_rank",
        "status_code_sum_1h_max_30m",
        "k_min_latency_ms",
        F.initcap(F.trim("host")).alias("host_title"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_k"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w10).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_rank"),
        F.count("latency_ms_dense_rank").over(w11).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_count_30d"),
        F.rank().over(w12).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_rank_2"),
        F.round((F.col("k_min_latency_ms") / F.sum("k_min_latency_ms").over(w8)), 4).alias("k_min_latency_ms_share"),
    )
)

summary = (
    metrics
    .rollup("k")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("k")).alias("k_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", F.col("status_code_sum_1h")).otherwise(0)).alias("region_status_code_sum_1h"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("region_latency_ms_dense_rank_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code_sum_1h", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_code_sum_1h_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("version_rows") >= 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "k",
        "version_rows",
        "region_status_code_sum_1h",
        "status_code_sum_1h_quartiles",
        F.when(F.col("k").rlike("^(trace|region)$"), "CORE").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("k_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("region_status_code_sum_1h").desc())
)
```

```python
    .select(
```
```python
        "id",
```

```python
    .withColumn("corr_latency_ms_status_code", F.corr("latency_ms", "status_code").over(w))

    .withColumn("attr_key_avg_latency_ms_share", F.avg("latency_ms_share").over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(w))
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
```

```sql
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 END) AS cash_count,
```

```sql
        *,
```

```sql
    FROM device_readings

    FROM base
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps

    CASE WHEN pressure_adjusted >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS pressure_adjusted_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    COUNT_IF(device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_events,
    SUM(humidity) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_total_humidity,
    MAX(reading_ts) AS last_seen,
    MIN(reading_ts) AS started_at
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_bits_whole >= 65 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN pressure_adjusted >= 83 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("pressure_adjusted", F.round((F.col("pressure") * 0.85), 2))
    .withColumn("status_bits_whole", F.ceil("status_bits"))
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_whole") >= 65, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_bits_whole_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("pressure_adjusted") >= 83, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("pressure_adjusted_tier"),
```

```python
lines = (
```
```python
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
```
```python
        "service",
```
```python
        "latency_ms",
```
```python
        "status_code",
```

```python
    )

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(

        "status_code",

        (F.col("status_code_high") + F.col("status_code")).alias("status_code_high_plus_status_code"),
    )
)

daily = (
    base
    .groupBy(
```

```sql
        status,
```

```sql
    from payments
    where paid_at >= to_date('2023-06-06')

      and paid_at >= '2025-10-27'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        ntile(5) over (partition by status order by amount desc, id) as amount_bucket,
        avg(amount_whole) over (partition by status order by amount, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as amount_whole_avg_6_prior,
        ntile(4) over w_recent as amount_whole_bucket,
        ntile(5) over w_hist as amount_whole_bucket_2
    from valid
    window w_recent as (partition by status order by amount_whole desc, id), w_hist as (order by amount_whole, id)
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        amount_whole,
        method_clean,
        amount_bucket,
        amount_whole_avg_6_prior,
        amount_whole_bucket,
        amount_whole_bucket_2,
        sum(amount_whole_avg_6_prior) over (order by amount_whole, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount_whole_avg_6_prior,
        min(amount_whole_avg_6_prior) over (partition by status) as status_min_amount_whole_avg_6_prior,
        avg(amount_whole) over (partition by status order by amount_whole_bucket_2, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as amount_whole_avg_2_prior,
        sum(amount) over (partition by status order by amount_whole_bucket_2, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount
    from with_windows
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        last_value(running_amount) ignore nulls over (partition by status order by running_amount, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_running_amount,
        sum(status_min_amount_whole_avg_6_prior) over (partition by status order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 7776000 preceding and current row) as status_min_amount_whole_avg_6_prior_sum_90d,

        round(amount_whole_bucket_2 / sum(amount_whole_bucket_2) over (partition by status), 4) as amount_whole_bucket_2_share
    from scored
    window w_part as (order by running_amount_whole_avg_6_prior desc nulls last)
),
enriched_payments as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        lag(amount_bucket, 1) over (order by amount_whole_bucket, id) as prev_amount_bucket,

    from enriched
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_sum_7d,
        LAST_VALUE(method) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY burst_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_method,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY burst_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_burst_id
    FROM sessionized
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        new_group_flag,
        burst_id,
        burst_id_sum_7d,
        last_known_method,
        cumulative_burst_id,
        SUM(burst_id_sum_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cumulative_burst_id, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_burst_id_sum_7d,
        MIN(cumulative_burst_id) OVER w_recent AS status_min_cumulative_burst_id,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER w_recent AS status_sum_new_group_flag
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY status)
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN status_sum_new_group_flag >= 3 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS status_sum_new_group_flag_tier,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(burst_id, 0.9) AS burst_id_p90,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY status_sum_new_group_flag_tier
)
SELECT status_sum_new_group_flag_tier
FROM summary
ORDER BY status_sum_new_group_flag_tier
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "method").orderBy("burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cumulative_burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status")

flagged = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("cumulative_burst_id_sum_7d", F.sum("burst_id_sum_7d").over(w6))
    .withColumn("status_min_cumulative_burst_id", F.min("cumulative_burst_id").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("status_sum_new_group_flag", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w_recent))
)
```

```sql
    COUNT_IF(country = 'SG') AS sg_events,
```

```sql
        sub.monthly_fee
```

```sql
        ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND s.opened_date >= sub.start_date

latest AS (

),
ranked AS (

    FROM latest
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN subscription_id >= 10 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS subscription_id_tier,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'standard') AS standard_events,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(subscription_id, 0.5) AS subscription_id_p50,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(account_type)) AS account_type_list
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN subscription_id >= 10 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
)
SELECT
    subscription_id_tier,
    standard_events,
    subscription_id_p50,
    account_type_list
FROM totals;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id", "subscription_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("opened_date", "id", "subscription_id")

    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
```

```sql
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        COALESCE(unit_price, 0) AS unit_price_filled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(unit_price, 0) AS unit_price_filled_2
    FROM base
    WHERE product_id IN (12, 21, 24)

enriched AS (

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        CORR(unit_price, quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS corr_unit_price_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_2_prior,
        LAG(unit_price, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS prev_unit_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price_filled_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS unit_price_filled_2_cume_dist
    FROM valid
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(unit_price_filled_2) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS last_known_unit_price_filled_2,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_avg_quantity
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price_filled_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id, order_id
    FROM metrics
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.order_id = k.order_id
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN quantity_avg_2_prior >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS quantity_avg_2_prior_tier,
    product_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(last_known_unit_price_filled_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last_known_unit_price_filled_2_quartiles
FROM verified
GROUP BY CASE WHEN quantity_avg_2_prior >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, product_id
HAVING SUM(quantity) > 0
ORDER BY product_id DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("unit_price_filled", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_filled_2").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price_filled_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.coalesce("unit_price", F.lit(0)).alias("unit_price_filled"),
    )
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([12, 21, 24]))
    .withColumn("unit_price_filled_2", F.coalesce("unit_price", F.lit(0)))
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.corr("unit_price", "quantity").over(w2).alias("corr_unit_price_quantity"),

        F.lag("unit_price", 2).over(w4).alias("prev_unit_price"),

)

verified = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")

)

result = (

    .agg(
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
        F.bit_or("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_or"),
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_unit_price_filled_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last_known_unit_price_filled_2_quartiles"),
```

```sql
WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM sessions
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    browser,
    customer_id,
    MAX(started_at) AS last_seen,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN session_id ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_session_id,
    COUNT_IF(browser = 'Chrome') AS chrome_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'mobile') AS mobile_rows
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY browser, customer_id
ORDER BY desktop_session_id NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy("browser", "customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("started_at").alias("last_seen"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", F.col("session_id")).otherwise(0)).alias("desktop_session_id"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Chrome").alias("chrome_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("desktop_session_id").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS greatest_units_revenue_percent_rank_2,

        SUM(greatest_units_revenue) OVER w_hist AS store_id_sum_greatest_units_revenue
    FROM base
```

```python
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("greatest_units_revenue").asc_nulls_last())

    df_store_sales
    .select("product_id", "store_id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([5, 6, 10]))
        .select("product_id", "store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.store_name"))
)

    .withColumn("greatest_units_revenue_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

)
```

```sql
select
    store_id,
    bit_or(units) as units_bit_or,
```

```sql
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN end_date_period - LAG(end_date_period) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date_period, id) > INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
sessions_subscriptions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date_plus_31d DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM sessions_subscriptions
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
deduped_subscriptions AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date_period DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.age,
        p.country
    FROM deduped_subscriptions a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date) AS activity_month,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(island_id, 0.95) AS island_id_p95,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status
FROM enriched
GROUP BY activity_month
ORDER BY num_status NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("end_date_plus_31d").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("end_date_period").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-05-24").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) x AS key, v

        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id

    FROM with_window

filtered AS (

    FROM deduped
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,

        COUNT(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_count_monthly_fee
    FROM filtered

    SELECT
        key,
        plan,
        plan_count_monthly_fee
    FROM metrics

    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR plan IN ('standard', 'enterprise', 'basic')
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id", "key", "subscription_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "plan").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id", "key", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "key").orderBy(F.col("subscription_id").desc(), "id", "key", "subscription_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan")

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.email"), F.col("c.signup_date"))

    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.signup_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.signup_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "inner")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```sql
with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status,
        date_format(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM') as paid_at_label
    from payments
    where method != 'bank_transfer'
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(paid_at) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id) is null
                 or paid_at > lag(paid_at) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id) + interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from base
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by status order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from gaps
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from sessionized
    qualify row_number() over (partition by status order by burst_id, id) = 1
)
select
    id,
    method,
    paid_at,
    status,
    paid_at_label,
    burst_id,
    case when status rlike '^(SUCCESS|FAILED)$' then 'EXTENDED' when status rlike '^(REFUNDED)$' then 'CORE' else 'GROUP_B' end as status_zone
from latest;
```

```python
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method") != "bank_transfer")
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.date_format("paid_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("paid_at_label"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

latest = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(

        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "paid_at_label",
        "burst_id",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(SUCCESS|FAILED)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(REFUNDED)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("status_zone"),
```

```sql
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT

    tier_value,
    tier_value_level
```

```sql
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        lower(merchant) as merchant_lower
    from transactions
    where txn_time >= timestamp '2023-10-05 09:00:00'
      and merchant is not null
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id) is null
                 or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id) + interval 30 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from valid
),
sessions_transactions as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from gaps
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select account_id, merchant
    from sessions_transactions
    intersect
    select account_id, merchant
    from transactions
    where not is_flagged
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from sessions_transactions s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.account_id = k.account_id and s.merchant = k.merchant
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        initcap(trim(merchant)) as merchant_title,
        session_no - is_new_burst as session_no_minus_is_new_burst
    from verified
    where merchant not in ('7-Eleven', 'Shell')
)
select
    id,
    account_id,
    merchant_lower,
    is_new_burst,
    session_no,
    merchant_title,
    session_no_minus_is_new_burst
from filtered
order by account_id nulls last;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-05 09:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lower("merchant").alias("merchant_lower"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

remaining_keys = (
    sessions_transactions
    .select("account_id", "merchant")
    .intersect(
        df_transactions
        .filter(~F.col("is_flagged"))
        .select("account_id", "merchant")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessions_transactions
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter(~F.col("merchant").isin(["7-Eleven", "Shell"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("merchant")).alias("merchant_title"),
        (F.col("session_no") - F.col("is_new_burst")).alias("session_no_minus_is_new_burst"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "merchant_lower",
        "is_new_burst",
        "session_no",
        "merchant_title",
        "session_no_minus_is_new_burst",
    )
```

```sql
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        LEAD(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS next_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) AS seq_no
    FROM shipments
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) AS activity_month,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(cost, 0.9) AS cost_p90,
    MAX(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_max_cost,
    MIN(next_cost) AS min_next_cost,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date) ORDER BY PERCENTILE_APPROX(cost, 0.9) DESC) AS cost_p90_percent_rank
FROM scored
GROUP BY 1, 2;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("quarter_start").orderBy(F.col("cost_p90").desc())

scored = (
    df_shipments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("cost", 1).over(w).alias("next_cost"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "delivered_date").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("cost", 0.9).alias("cost_p90"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", F.col("cost"))).alias("returned_max_cost"),
        F.min("next_cost").alias("min_next_cost"),
    )
    .withColumn("cost_p90_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
)
```

```sql
    CASE WHEN attr_key_count_status_code_high >= 15 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS attr_key_count_status_code_high_tier,

    APPROX_PERCENTILE(status_code_high_cume_dist, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS status_code_high_cume_dist_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(status_code_high_cume_dist) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN attr_key = 'region' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS status_code_high_cume_dist_per_region,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("service", "host").orderBy(F.col("host_count_latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("host", "key")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("key_max_latency_ms").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = (

    .select(

        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",

    flattened
    .select(
```

```python
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
```
